$comment: Registry of pnpm audit advisories we have reviewed and chosen to ignore. Every GHSA listed under auditConfig.ignoreGhsas in pnpm-workspace.yaml MUST have exactly one entry here. tests/security/ignored-advisories.test.ts fails once reviewBy has passed, once a patched version is installed, or if the two lists drift apart. Re-review: run `npm view <package> versions` and read the advisory; if still unpatched, bump reviewedOn/reviewBy (max 30-day window).

ignores.exposure: dev-only. Pulled in by micromatch for jest and lint-staged glob expansion; patterns come from repository config, never from untrusted input. Stack-exhaustion DoS is not reachable in production.
dev-only. Pulled in by argparse 1.x via js-yaml 3.x for jest coverage config loading; format strings are fixed library constants, never user input.
